Adversarial tests assert the EXPECTED behaviour and fail against HEAD where a break is confirmed.

AGGREGATE RUNS (VERIFIED): `cd apps/mobile && npx jest __tests__/adv/` → exit 1, Test Suites: 5 failed, 1 passed, 6 total; Tests: 12 failed, 6 passed, 18 total (every failure is a confirmed break listed in `breaks`; log artifacts/adv/mobile-adv-all.log, uploaded). `deno test -A --no-check --config supabase/functions/api/__wf__/deno.json supabase/functions/api/__wf__/adv_perf_bounds.test.ts` → exit 0, 4 passed, 0 failed (30 s; artifacts/adv/adv_perf_bounds.log, uploaded). Static gates: `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (artifacts/adv/mobile-tsc.log); root `npx eslint apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/ supabase/functions/api/__wf__/adv_perf_bounds.test.ts` exit 0; `cd apps/mobile && npx prettier --check __tests__/adv/*.ts` exit 0; `cd supabase/functions/api && deno fmt --check __wf__/adv_perf_bounds.test.ts && deno lint __wf__/adv_perf_bounds.test.ts && (cd __wf__ && deno check --config deno.json adv_perf_bounds.test.ts)` all exit 0.

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (VERIFIED, passing evidence):
1. Large library / quadratic history+Progress: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest __tests__/adv/perfLargeLibraryProgress.test.ts` → exit 0, 1 passed. Real SQLite: 300 guided captures (566,100 B payload) load 11–12 ms + Progress aggregation 17–18 ms, verified 300; 3,000 captures (5,661,000 B) load 74–87 ms + aggregate 23–27 ms, verified 3,000 — linear, inside the 1,500 ms budget, ratio < 12.
2. Outbox drain under total network loss with a 600-row backlog: perfOutboxBacklogNetworkLoss 'offline drain' case passed — 1 request, 50 rows touched (bounded batch), 64 ms, remaining 600, attempts stay 0 (transient loss does not consume the retry budget).
3. Outbox permanent per-item rejection over 12 drains: passed — exactly 8 requests (OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS), max attempts 8, rows parked (remaining 50 every pass) and never deleted; no unbounded retry.
4. Outbox unacknowledged HTTP 200 (server omits per-item acks) over 12 drains: passed — 12 requests, attempts 0, rows retained, last_error bounded at 113 chars.
5. Imported analysis cancellation after the sidecar read: passed — AbortSignal → outcome unavailable/cancelled in 1 ms, 0 permit requests (no long-running import without cancellation on this path).
6. Edge cold start + served bundle: `adv_perf_bounds.test.ts` cold start (import index.ts → 200 /healthz) 78 ms; module graph 21 modules / 452,491 B (18 local files) — passed budget.
7. Edge slow-loris body: 408 'Request body was not received in time.' after 30,015 ms (BODY_TIMEOUT 30 s); /healthz answered in 1 ms during the stall. Note: the harness logged `upstream cancelled=false` plus a Deno legacy request-abort warning — the timeout is verified, upstream signal propagation is UNKNOWN (not claimed).
8. Edge 32 concurrent 1 MiB streamed bodies at a 64 KiB route: all 413, heapUsed 90.8 MB → 92.7 MB (+1,876,832 B) — bounded body reader holds.
9. Edge maximal 200-shot sync batch (4,029,011 B): 200 in 130 ms, 200 accepted, 1 replay SELECT, 200 RPCs (no N+1 replay lookups); fully malformed 200-shot batch (4,029,211 B): 200 in 25 ms, 200 rejected, 0 shot queries.
10. JS parsePoseSequence throughput: 19,000 frames / 15.7 MB parsed in 282–333 ms (no quadratic parse; the missing bound itself is in `breaks`).

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (needs Mac/device; no verdict given): native capture/import bounds (maximumDurationSeconds=60, maximumSidecarBytes=16 MiB, frame-count receipt, low-disk, cancellation and temp-file cleanup of the Swift import/extraction path), memory growth across repeated capture/replay cycles on device, Hermes-thread timing of segmentPhases and the consistency replay, and app cold start. Exact Mac commands: `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` (local on the M4 runner — NOT `--remote`, per instructions); `cd native && swift test`; `cd apps/mobile/ios && bundle exec pod install && xcodebuild test -workspace PickleSensei.xcworkspace -scheme PickleSensei -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'`; Instruments Allocations/Leaks template over ≥20 capture→analyze→replay cycles on a physical iPhone; `xcrun xctrace record --template 'App Launch'` for cold start. Load tests in tools/loadtest (k6) were NOT run: they require a disposable Supabase project and were out of bounds here (production ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib must not be targeted).
